posts.text: Ostrand cutting a ribbon on a highway while my fuel bill went up again? Nice photo. Ask the farmers in the north what 'prosperity' costs per litre of diesel. #VeloriaVotes

Two stories today: VBC on the Kessa–North highway opening, Kito TV on the first debate and the costings questions both candidates faced. Before sharing, check the source and the numbers. Want to see the debate costings? Ask the moderators' fact sheet or the election commission's site. #VeloriaVotes
Ostrand says inflation is 'under control'. My grocery bill says otherwise. Curious which numbers the VBC crowd is using. #Veloria2024

Watched the Kito debate tonight. Ostrand talked inflation, Arden talked 200,000 jobs. Nobody answered the costings question properly. Anyone else tired of numbers that never add up? Hospitals are still short-staffed, whoever wins.

Watched the debate tonight. Ostrand's inflation numbers look better on the slide than they feel at the supermarket, and Arden's 200,000 jobs need a costing before I believe them. Both sides owe us the arithmetic. Fact-check everything, friends.

Saw the highway opening on VBC and the debate on Kito TV tonight. Roads are good, but my grocery prices are still bruising my wallet. Both of them need to show me the numbers. As my mother said: a promise is a loan.

Ostrand cutting a ribbon on a highway = 'new era of prosperity' lmao. Arden promising 200k jobs with zero costings = also cringe. Two weeks left and I still don't know who to trust. Someone pls convince me

Finally a new highway from Kessa to the North. My cab will thank the president, the suspension definitely won't. Ostrand's debate answer on inflation was solid though, let's see what the costings say. #Veloria
Fuel up 40% and they want five more years? Every litre of diesel I buy in the north says the same thing. Read the numbers yourselves before you vote. #VeloriaVotes

Fact-check says Arden's plan doesn't double VAT, and the '40% fuel' figure is from a peak month. Fair. But the same check says the plan leaves a gap of about 2% of GDP. Nobody gets credit for that part. Costings matter in both directions. #VeloriaVotes

Fact-check roundup from VeriCheck: Arden's plan does NOT double VAT (false), and the '40% fuel' figure uses a peak month (misleading). Economists also flag a gap of about 2% of GDP in his costings. Read both candidates' numbers yourself before sharing. #VeloriaVotes

Two weeks out and both candidates are still promising stuff without showing the math. Ostrand's inflation slide vs my grocery receipt? Lol no. Arden's 200k jobs with no costings? Pass. Somebody just show me the numbers and I'll decide myself #VeloriaVotes

Two weeks to go and my fuel bill is still the only thing I can count on. Ostrand's highway looks nice though, my suspension says thanks in advance. Still want to see the costings from both sides before I decide. #Veloria

Fact-check says Arden's plan doesn't double VAT, and the '40% fuel' number is a peak month. Fine. But the same check says a ~2% of GDP gap. Both sides owe us the arithmetic. Who's publishing the full costings?
Hospitals are still short-staffed no matter who wins. Both debates skipped the costings for staffing. Tonight I'm asking the same question to both camps: where's the money for nurses? #VeloriaVotes

VBC is airing a clip 'raising questions' about Arden, and the Civic Front says it isn't genuine. Before it spreads: who published the original file, when, and has anyone verified the audio? Ask the source, check VeriCheck, and wait for an independent forensic read before sharing. #VeloriaVotes

Recording on VBC tonight, and the Civic Front says it's fake. Before anyone decides what it means, who is verifying the audio? Ask for the original file and chain of custody, not just a clip played in full. #VeloriaVotes

Watched the VBC clip twice. A 'recording' with no provenance, no date, no chain of custody, and a 'questions raised' headline doing all the work. Ask who has the original file and whether the Civic Front has been asked for a forensic check. Until then I'm waiting for evidence before I judge. #VeloriaVotes

Two forwards today: a 'leaked' Arden audio and VBC saying 'questions raised' while the Civic Front calls it fake. Nobody has verified either. Before you forward, check who is sharing it and whether anyone has authenticated the file. Still want the costings from BOTH sides. Where's the money for nurses?

Everyone sharing the 'leaked Arden audio' before checking: VBC itself says 'questions raised' and the Civic Front says it's fake. Wait for proof. Sharing unverified clips is how we get fooled. Show me the source file. #VeloriaVotes

VBC is playing a 'recording' of Arden like it's gospel and nobody's asking where it came from? Chain of custody, metadata, anyone? Not defending him, just not sharing a clip I can't verify. Two weeks out and everyone wants my vote on vibes. #VeloriaVotes

Ledger says a deputy minister's relative got road contracts. Ministry says 'fabricated'. Before anyone repeats it: who has the documents, and has anyone checked them? Same standard for every story, whichever side it helps. #VeloriaVotes

Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided. Within the margin of error, so nobody should be celebrating or panicking yet. Wherever you land, I'd still like to see both camps show their full costings. Hospitals need staff, not slogans. #VeloriaVotes

Kito's poll has Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. That's a dead heat, so the Ledger's road-funds story matters more than usual. Before we treat it as settled, has the ministry's 'fabricated' claim been checked against the documents? Same rule for both sides. #VeloriaVotes

Day 4 check before sharing anything: the 'Arden running mate holds a foreign passport' claim is from Veloria Patriots Daily, with no source or document attached. Look for the passport record or an official statement before it spreads. Kito TV's poll (46-44, ±3) is a statement of a snapshot, not a result. #VeloriaVotes

Patriots Daily says Arden's running mate has a foreign passport and will sell the port, Kito says Ostrand 46 Arden 44. Cool, which headline do I screenshot first? Neither comes with a source file or a costings sheet, so I'm sitting this one out till somebody shows the math. #VeloriaVotes

Poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided. That's inside the ±3 margin, so basically a coin toss with two weeks to go. My cab's fuel bill is still undecided too. Show me the costings from both sides. #Veloria

Poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, margin ±3. That's a tie with extra steps. Anyone know which pollster weighted by region? Fuel's still 40% up in the north so I'm not holding my breath for either of them. #VeloriaVotes

Kito poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, margin ±3. That's a dead heat. Ten percent undecided is a lot with nine days left. Check the poll's sample and method before you panic or celebrate. As my mother said: count the eggs after the hen lays them. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5, 8 days out. Two tags trending, #ArdenWillSellUs and #OstrandFailedUs, and researchers say dozens of accounts behind each were made this month and posted near-identical text. Before you pick a side, check who's actually behind the tags. The VeloResults portal publishes scanned forms, so we can verify the counts ourselves.

Day 5 and my cab is running on fumes and forwarded 'ambassador' bonus offers. Paid per vote? That's not campaigning, that's a bounty. Anyone who wants my vote can show the costings AND explain who pays the 5k vel. #VeloriaVotes

Dead heat, 46-44 with 10% still undecided and nine days left. Before anyone celebrates or panics: who ran the poll, what's the sample, how were the regions weighted? Count the eggs after the hen lays them. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5 check: the Commission says polling-station forms get scanned and uploaded to the public VeloResults portal, and observers are invited to a system test. Good. Go look at how results are transmitted before any 'rigged' claim spreads. Procedure first, rumours second. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5 and both hashtags are trending with 'dozens of new accounts posting identical text in minutes'. Who's astroturfing whom? Ban the bots, show the costings, and I'll think for myself. #VeloriaVotes

Forwarded 'community ambassador' bot links paying 2,000 vel to sign up and 5,000 vel if your station votes Unity? That's vote buying dressed up as a job. Don't click, report it, and screenshot before it gets deleted. #VeloriaVotes

Two forwards today, a 'leaked' Arden audio and a 'Unity ambassador' bot offering 5k vel per polling station. Neither has a source I can check. Before I share anything: who published it, and where's the file? Hospitals still need staff, so show me both costings. #VeloriaVotes

Kito's poll is 46-44 with 10% undecided and ±3. That's a dead heat. Before anyone claims momentum, the Ledger's road-funds story needs its documents checked, same standard whichever side it hurts. Both camps owe us full costings. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. Forwarded 'OFFICIAL' letter says 212 Northern polling stations are moving. Before anyone travels or tells their neighbours: check the IECV website or the official notice board, not the WhatsApp group. Two weeks of forwards and no source yet. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. Kito's TV clip of Ostrand mangling a town name is going around as 'a slip'. Fair enough, we all trip on names. Before we decide what it means, what's the full clip, and does anyone have the uncut version? Same standard for every clip, #VeloriaVotes

Day 6 and the 'OFFICIAL LETTER' moving 212 northern polling stations is going round WhatsApp with no date, no reference number, no link to the IECV site. Before you pack your bag for the wrong school hall, check the Commission's own page or call them. Forwarding unchecked is how we get stranded. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. Forwarded 'OFFICIAL LETTER' says 212 Northern polling stations are moving 'for security'. Who signed it? Check the IECV site or ask a poll worker before you go. Not sharing it till I see the notice. Costings from both sides still matter more than forwards. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6 check on the Kito TV clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a town name: it's a real, viral clip, but the 'slip of the tongue' spin is still just a claim. Look for the full uncut recording and the original broadcast timestamp before anyone calls it a gaffe or a smear. Same standard for every clip. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6 and the Kito clip of Ostrand mangling a town name is everywhere. Slip of the tongue? Sure. Still want the full unedited video before I decide it means anything. Both candidates, same standard. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6, 7 days out. Forwarded 'OFFICIAL' IECV letter moving 212 Northern stations? Check the Commission's own site and VeloResults before you believe it or go to the wrong school. Procedure first, rumours second. #VeloriaVotes

Kito's 46-44 with 10% undecided and ±3 is a dead heat, and the day 5 chatter about 'momentum' is premature. Before we credit either camp, the Ledger's road-funds documents need checking against the ministry's 'fabricated' claim. Same standard whichever side it hurts. #VeloriaVotes

Silence starts tonight, so this is my last word before polls. Ostrand 46, Arden 44, ten percent undecided, margin ±3. A dead heat. Before you decide, go read the Ledger's road-funds documents and the ministry's denial side by side. Both camps owe us full costings. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, silence starts tonight. Forwarded voice note says 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered' — that's not a turnout message, it's a demobilization line. Who sent it, and where's the source? Vote your own way, check the IECV notice. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. The Commission says stop campaigning until polls close, and that includes the 'stay home, we've got it covered' voice note doing the rounds. Vote or don't vote, but decide from the official notices and the VeloResults portal, not a forwarded voice note. Count the eggs after the hen lays them. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7: campaign silence starts tonight, per the IECV. Before polls close, check your own facts: the official IECV site and VeloResults, not the WhatsApp 'OFFICIAL' letters. Procedure first, rumours second. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight and Zuri K is dropping 'Arden is a danger to our children' like it's a verdict. Cool song, zero costings. Mute both hashtags till polls close and let the VeloResults forms do the talking. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. Got a 'Tomas Arden' voice note in the group telling everyone to stay home tomorrow. Not sharing that, and not voting for anyone who wants me to skip the booth. Check the IECV site for the actual rules and go vote. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. Singer endorsement clip is trending, but the Commission says no campaigning after this. Watch what gets pushed past the deadline and check who's posting it. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, silence starts tonight and the WhatsApp voice note telling us to 'stay home tomorrow' is what I'd call a warning sign. Who benefits if nobody votes? Check the IECV site before you believe any of it. Fuel's still 40% up in the north and I want both camps' costings on paper before I decide. #VeloriaVotes

Election day in Veloria and the northern stations are still on the paper register because the ID kits failed. Did anyone actually see the IECV notice or is this another forward? Before I believe a 'pre-stuffed' photo from a school, I want the source. Fuel's still 40% up in the north, and I'd like both camps' costings on paper before I vote. #VeloriaVotes

Election day in Veloria. Polls are open and the IECV says turnout is high. Some ID kits failed up north and they switched to the printed register, as the law allows. Check your station on the IECV site, not the WhatsApp forwards. Vote your own way. #VeloriaVotes

Polls are open and the IECV has confirmed the printed register fallback is lawful. Before we read anything into the 'restrictions' or 'stay home' voice notes, check the Commission's own notices and VeloResults. Vote, then judge the costings on both sides. #VeloriaVotes

Election day in Veloria. Polls are open. If your ID kit failed, the printed register is legal, so don't turn back. Don't trust the 'ballot boxes stuffed' photo or the forwarded 'stay home' note until you see a source. Check IECV and VeloResults. Go vote. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, polls open. Turnout looks high. Reports of some voter-ID kit failures in the North: officials say they switched to the printed register, which is allowed. Check the IECV site or your station's notice board, not forwards. Go vote. #VeloriaVotes

Election day in Veloria and the Commission says some ID kits failed up north, so they switched to the printed register. Fine, that's the law working. Still not sharing any 'stay home' voice notes or 'restricted platforms' gossip. Check IECV for your station, then go vote. #VeloriaVotes

Election day in Veloria. Polls are open and the IECV says the printed register is the legal fallback where the ID kits failed. Real procedure. Check the Commission's site before you believe any 'pre-stuffed boxes' photo. Vote your own way. #VeloriaVotes

Election day. Polls are open and the Commission says turnout is high. Some kits failed in the north and officials switched to the printed register, which is what the law allows. Check the IECV site and VeloResults before you believe any 'official' notice. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9: Kito TV has two tallies with different station samples, and they point opposite ways (Arden 51-47 vs Ostrand 53-45). Neither is a result yet. Wait for the official VeloResults count and the IECV's own figures before anyone declares a winner. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 and the Civic Front page says Arden WON with 'agent tallies' and wants Ostrand to concede. Kito and VBC tallies point opposite ways because they count different stations first. Where are the actual polling station forms? Show me the VeloResults numbers before anyone concedes. Fuel's still 40% up up north, and that's why I care. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 (counting). Kito TV has two tallies with different stations counted first, so Arden 51-47 and Ostrand 53-45 can both be 'true' and still tell you nothing yet. Wait for the full VeloResults count before anyone starts a victory lap. Procedure first, rumours second. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Still waiting on VeloResults before I believe any headline number. Kito's tally and VBC's disagree because they counted different stations first. Ordinary nurses don't need a 'FINAL RESULTS' from an unverified account. Check the official count when it lands. #VeloriaVotes

Election day, and the 'FINAL RESULTS' post from @IECV_Results is already trending. Nothing official has been released yet, and that account isn't verified. Wait for the Commission's own tally on VeloResults before you believe a percentage. Two stations in, and the two TV tallies already disagree. #VeloriaVotes

Two tallies, two different samples: Kito's 51-47 Arden on 30% of stations, VBC's 53-45 Ostrand on 25%. Early returns that counted different stations first tell us very little yet. Wait for the full count and the IECV's own tally before anyone declares a result. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9, two weeks... no, election is done and the count is in progress. Kito TV has two tallies with different stations counted first. Don't pick the one you like. Wait for VeloResults to publish the full count. Hen first, eggs after. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8 and the 'FINAL RESULTS 54.2%' post from @IECV_Results is already trending. Official Commission counts haven't even closed. Check VeloResults, not some random account. Results come from the tally, not a tweet. #VeloriaVotes
Day 10. Still only 41% of forms on VeloResults and the portal can't show a province winner. Anyone calling it final is ahead of the data. Wait for the Commission's full count. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. Still only 41% of polling-station forms on VeloResults, so no province-level winner can be shown yet. VeriCheck is right that the '9 of 14' claim doesn't hold. Wait for the full IECV tally before anyone concedes or celebrates. Both camps' costings still matter too. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10 (counting). Two things to keep in mind: VeloResults is only showing 41% of station forms, so there's no province-level winner yet, and the '9 of 14 provinces' claim is false per VeriCheck. Wait for the IECV's full tally before believing any headline. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10 counting. VeloResults is still 41% online and the 'Arden won 9 of 14 provinces' page is pointing to a portal that's been switched off. Screenshot ain't a tally. Wait for the IECV numbers, then we can all be angry properly. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10 (counting). Still no VeloResults upload for 59% of stations because of a 'technical glitch'. Until the IECV publishes the forms, every 'FINAL RESULTS' screenshot is just noise. Wait for the Commission, then argue. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 (counting). The 'FINAL RESULTS 54.2%' post is going round but nothing official is out yet. Two TV tallies, two different sets of stations counted first. Wait for VeloResults and the IECV's own count before anyone calls it. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9, counting still going. The 'FINAL RESULTS 54.2%' post from @IECV_Results isn't verified and nothing official is out yet. Wait for VeloResults, not screenshots. Fuel's still 40% up in the north and I want the real numbers before I believe anyone. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9, still counting. Two TV tallies, two different sets of stations counted first, so neither tells us much yet. Don't pick the number you like. Wait for VeloResults to publish the full count and check the IECV's own figures. Patience, like rain before harvest. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IECV has declared Mara Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. Official count, official declaration. Congrats to the winner and thanks to the poll workers who counted through all those 'glitches'. Now let's all get back to work. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11: IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to Arden's 47.9%, turnout 68%. The observer mission flagged skewed state broadcast coverage and transmission delays, so raise those with the Commission and check VeloResults for the forms. Concession or not, the procedure has to be shown. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IECV has declared it: Ostrand re-elected 50.6%, Arden 47.9%, turnout 68%. Official count, so that's the result. Congrats to Mara's side. Now let's see the forms and hear the losing side's objections through proper channels. Back to the fare meter. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected at 50.6% vs Arden 47.9%, turnout 68%. Official figures, so that's the number. Recounts or challenges go through the proper channels, not screenshots. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IECV has declared it: Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Official count, so we take it. Those 15 timeline posts saying 'wait for the Commission' just got their answer. Now the real question is what happens to fuel and nurse staffing. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11 and the Commission says Ostrand 50.6%. Civic Front says the servers were hacked and they won't accept it. Fine, take it to the Supreme Court. But show the station forms first. Where are the polling-station numbers on VeloResults? Fuel's still 40% up up north and I'd like to know who I'm actually paying for it. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. The Commission has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. Observers flag skewed state coverage and transmission delays, which deserve scrutiny. A 2.7-point margin is real but narrow, and the economics debate ahead matters more than the headline. Read the full IECV tally before deciding what it means. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11 and the IECV is out: Ostrand 50.6%, Arden 47.9%, turnout 68%. Official count, so finally something to argue about with receipts. Civic Front can keep the 'agent tallies' energy, but the Commission has spoken. Now show me the forms, not the feelings. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito says the Supreme Court is ordering supervised access to the commission's servers and logs. VBC shows burning tyres in Kessa with no context. Whatever you think of the result, the procedure is what can be checked. Show the forms. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito says the Supreme Court is ordering supervised access to the servers and logs. Good. Show the polling-station forms on VeloResults too, not just the 50.6 headline. Fuel's still 40% up up north and I'd like to know the numbers behind this mess. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito says the Civic Front petition is going to supervised server access, so the court is checking the logs. Good. Whatever the outcome, the forms and the logs are what should settle it. Fuel and nurse staffing still matter more to me than the headline. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. VBC shows burning tyres in Kessa and calls it 'opposition riots'. Kito says the Supreme Court is forcing the commission to open its servers to both sides. Whatever you think of the result, watch what each outlet leaves out and wait for the court's findings. Hen first, eggs after. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12: Two things to hold together. VBC's 'riot in Kessa' clip and the Kito report on the petition are different stories, so don't let one stand in for the other. Footage needs a time and place. The court order for supervised server access is the process that will actually settle the dispute. Check the filing and the access terms, not the reactions. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito reports the Supreme Court has ordered supervised access to the Commission's servers and logs for both sides. That is the right response to a petition like this. Whatever the logs show, the process is now being checked in the open, and 2.7 points is narrow enough that the logs matter. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12 and the Supreme Court just ordered supervised access to the servers and logs. Good. Now both sides can look at the same data instead of screenshots. VBC's riot footage is still on loop though. Show me the forms, not the vibes. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito says the Supreme Court is ordering supervised access to the commission's servers and logs. Good. Let the forms and logs speak, same as we all asked for on day 9. Still not sure Kessa's 'riot' footage and the burning tyres tell me much on their own though. Who was there? #VeloriaVotes
